description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Direct Push Crosshole Testing: Assessment of Post-liquefaction Soil Saturation and Stiffness in Kawaihae Harbor, Hawaii is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kenneth Stokoe, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). The project's main focus is on studying soil conditions, particularly saturation and stiffness, to evaluate the possibility of soil liquefaction recurring after the 2006 Kiholo Bay earthquake, using the direct push crosshole test (DCPH). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-t4bd-8w49. Keywords: NHERI Large-scale Mobile Shakers, Soil Liquefaction, Saturation, Stiffness, Compression (P-) Waves, and Shear (S-) Waves. Published 2023-08-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
